{b}Game Rules{/b} {fill}Magic Devil is a 6-reel video slot game with 576 to 147,456 ways to win. The game has a Scatter symbol, a Wild symbol, and four High and four Low symbols. The Wild substitutes for all other symbols except Scatter. Free Spins are played at the bet of the triggering spin. {color=#FFBF00}Wild Respin Bonus{/color} Stacked Wilds on reels 1 and 6 award a Free Respin on reels 2 to 5. The Stacked Wilds on reel 1 and 6 will be sticky for that respin. The Free Respin randomly lands Wilds with x1, x2, x3, x4 Multipliers on reels 2 to 5. Multiplier Wilds are treated as ways: x2 is 2 Wilds, x3 is 3 Wilds, x4 is 4 Wilds.
